verdict.rationale: Airwallex ships AgentOS, a toolkit letting external AI agents act on a production account (reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards, building cashflow reports), which shows some agentic delegation capability, but this is a developer toolkit/API surface for building agents rather than a built-in assistant embedded in the Airwallex product UI that end-users can directly delegate tasks to. missing for 10: evidence of a native, in-app AI assistant/chat interface for end users, first-party proof of an assistant surfaced in the dashboard rather than only API/toolkit access for developers.
